description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values for different morphosyntactic tags across several multilingual BERT model variants, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categorical variable labeled “tag,” with categories arranged left to right as case, gender, number, and a fourth unlabeled group at the far right; the vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 (values extend slightly above 20 and below 0). For each tag category, six adjacent bars are shown corresponding to the legend entries: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red), each with a vertical black error bar. In the case group, the bars are approximately 6 (mBERT-L₂), about 5.5 (XLM-L₂), about 2.8 (mBERT-R₂), about 2.1 (XLM-R₂), about 12.3 (mBERT-B₂), and about 11.2 (XLM-B₂). In the gender group, the bars are roughly 1.4 (mBERT-L₂), about 0.3 (XLM-L₂), about 1.8 (mBERT-R₂), about 1.1 (XLM-R₂), about 4.2 (mBERT-B₂), and about 3.4 (XLM-B₂). In the number group, the bars are approximately 1.2 (mBERT-L₂), about 0.9 (XLM-L₂), about 1.0 (mBERT-R₂), about 0.6 (XLM-R₂), about 2.7 (mBERT-B₂), and about 2.3 (XLM-B₂). In the unlabeled rightmost group, the bars are near 0.4 (mBERT-L₂), about −0.2 (XLM-L₂), about −0.1 (mBERT-R₂), about −0.2 (XLM-R₂), about 0.5 (mBERT-B₂), and about 0.6 (XLM-B₂). The bars within each group are arranged side-by-side (not stacked), there is no visible sorting by magnitude beyond the fixed legend order, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
